title: Pallet stack limit at ramp
explanation_template: At {time} pallets at the ramp exceed the allowed stack limit.
unsupported: Counting items stacked on top of each other cannot be expressed. count_in_zone counts separate objects standing on the floor and cannot count items in a stack, so 'pallets not higher than three pieces in a stack' is not measurable with the available primitives.
suggested_rewrite: Draw a zone called ramp_zone on this camera first, then: no more than three pallets may be present in ramp_zone. This approximates the stack limit by counting pallets in the zone.
